name: DataCite Commons and re3data
description: Two connected registries: re3data describes over 3,000 research data repositories worldwide with their subjects, policies, licences and API endpoints; DataCite Commons indexes the DOIs those repositories mint. Between them they answer 'where would data about X live' - the question that comes before any dataset search.

access.pagination: DataCite: page[number] and page[size], or cursor for large walks

probes.description: Every registered repository, as one XML index

gotchas.trap: The re3data list endpoint returns ids and names only; policies, APIs and licences need a second call per repository.
gotchas.fix: GET /api/v1/repository/<id> for the full record, and cache - there are 3,000 of them.

gotchas.trap: DataCite search is keyword over metadata, not over data contents.
gotchas.fix: Expect to follow the DOI to the repository to find out what the columns actually are.
